mapper.update: UPDATE agent_subagent_task SET status='RUNNING', lease_owner=#{workerId}, lease_expires_at=#{leaseExpiresAt}, fencing_token=fencing_token+1, attempt=attempt+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND deleted=0 AND (status='READY' OR (status='RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at < #{now}))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM agent_subagent_task WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND lease_owner=#{workerId} AND deleted=0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_subagent_task SET status=#{task.status}, result_text=#{task.resultText}, error_code=#{task.errorCode}, completed_at=#{task.completedAt}, lease_owner=NULL, lease_expires_at=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{task.tenantId} AND task_id=#{task.taskId} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_owner=#{workerId} AND fencing_token=#{fencingToken} AND lease_expires_at >= #{task.completedAt} AND deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM agent_orchestration_outbox WHERE ((status IN ('PENDING','RETRYING') AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (status='PUBLISHING' AND lease_expires_at < #{now})) AND attempt_count < max_attempts AND deleted=0 ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_orchestration_outbox SET status='PUBLISHING',lease_owner=#{owner},lease_expires_at=#{leaseExpiresAt}, fencing_token=fencing_token+1,attempt_count=attempt_count+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND event_id=#{eventId} AND deleted=0 AND attempt_count < max_attempts AND ((status IN ('PENDING','RETRYING') AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (status='PUBLISHING' AND lease_expires_at < #{now}))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM agent_orchestration_outbox WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND event_id=#{eventId} AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND status='PUBLISHING' AND deleted=0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_orchestration_outbox SET status=IF(attempt_count >= max_attempts,'DEAD','RETRYING'), next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt},last_error=#{lastError},lease_owner=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND event_id=#{eventId} AND status='PUBLISHING' AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND fencing_token=#{fencingToken} AND deleted=0

UPDATE agent_subagent_task SET callback_status='DELIVERING',callback_owner=#{callbackOwner}, callback_claimed_at=#{now},callback_attempt=callback_attempt+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND status IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED','ACKED') AND (callback_status IN ('PENDING','RETRYING') OR (callback_status='DELIVERING' AND callback_claimed_at < DATE_SUB(#{now}, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE))) AND deleted=0

UPDATE agent_subagent_task SET callback_status='RETRYING',callback_last_error=#{lastError}, callback_owner=NULL,callback_claimed_at=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND callback_status='DELIVERING' AND callback_owner=#{callbackOwner} AND deleted=0

UPDATE agent_subagent_task SET status='ACKED',acknowledged_at=#{deliveredAt}, callback_status='DELIVERED',callback_delivered_at=#{deliveredAt},callback_owner=NULL,callback_claimed_at=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND parent_run_id=#{parentRunId} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND status IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED') AND callback_status='DELIVERING' AND callback_owner=#{callbackOwner} AND deleted=0

UPDATE agent_subagent_task SET status='READY',lease_owner=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND status='RUNNING' AND fencing_token=#{fencingToken} AND lease_expires_at=#{leaseExpiresAt} AND deleted=0

UPDATE agent_subagent_task SET callback_status='PENDING',callback_owner=NULL,callback_claimed_at=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND callback_status='DELIVERING' AND callback_owner=#{callbackOwner} AND callback_claimed_at=#{callbackClaimedAt} AND deleted=0

UPDATE agent_subagent_task SET callback_status='PENDING' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND parent_run_id=#{parentRunId} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND callback_status='RETRYING' AND callback_attempt < 12 AND status IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED') AND deleted=0
